title: Determine the Net Torque
text: What should the net torque be when the seesaw is balanced (in $$\text{N}\cdot\text{m})$$?

title: Calculate the Forces
text: The forces here are the weights of the children, each calculated as $$mg.$$ Both weights point down. The first child's weight produces a torque in the negative direction and the second child's weight produces a torque in the positive direction.

title: Use the Torque Formula
text: Recall the formula for torque: $$\tau=rF\sin\theta.$$ Here, $$\tau_{\text{net}}=-r_{1}m_{1}g+r_{2}m_{2}g=0.$$ Solve for $$r_{2}$$.
